# Card

Display elements and features related to one subject on a flexible container.
See [Card guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/card/design/)

The `ds-card` class simply gives a container the look of a card. Use the `ds-card--actionable` modifier for a clickable card, and/or the `ds-card--selected` one to bring focus to a specific card.

Inside the card, you may use different classes to style its content:

- `ds-card-media` to include an image or a video,
- `ds-card-content` to wrap the main content and give it some padding,
- `ds-card-title` for the card title,
- `ds-card-actions` for the card actions,
- `ds-card-header` for more complex headers.

<Canvas of={CardStories.Basic} />

Sample custom CSS used on this page examples

```css
.bg-coolgrey-10 {
  background-color: #eff1f4;
}
.p-2 {
  padding: 2rem;
}
.card-media {
  background-image: url(./thumbnail.png);
}
.card-lefticon {
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-left: -8px;
}
.h-112 {
  height: 112px;
}
```

As you can see in the example above, there are 2 ways of including a media: as a div background image (but it only works with images obviously), or by applying the `ds-card-media` to an img or video tag. Please note that in the second case, we use a CSS property that is not compatible with IE11.
